payload.text: A spherical balloon has radius increasing at 0.4 cm/s. Consider the instant when the radius is 6 cm.

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: Find the instantaneous rate of change of volume V=(4/3)πr³.

accepted_variants: Any algebraically equivalent form with correct reasoning.
criteria.minimum_fix: To earn this point, explicitly show 4πr²; 0.4; 57.6π.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Find the instantaneous rate of change of surface area S=4πr².

accepted_variants: Any algebraically equivalent form with correct reasoning.
criteria.minimum_fix: To earn this point, explicitly show 8πr; 0.4; 19.2π.

parts.label: (c)
parts.prompt: Explain why dV/dt is not constant even though dr/dt is constant.

criteria.description: The volume rate contains the changing factor r², so equal radial increases add larger shells as the balloon grows.
